integrity: Universal classification established by explicit three-round EF argument and set-exchange construction; finite checker corroborates selected cases. The source and review comparisons are not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary adjacency/equality FO and quantifier rank exactly three; does not cover higher ranks, counting logic, or metric-betweenness. A direct enumeration of 34 instances corroborates but cannot prove universal bounds. Related published triangular graph rank profiles cover only k=2; residual literature overlap with inaccessible or unindexed materials remains.
title: Seven rank-three theories of balanced finite Johnson graphs
